summary: Iteration 5 (App Store polish) — backend 19/19 pytest passing and full frontend smoke (signup → onboarding → home → mood → solve → garden → insights) all green. Validated 5-part mood analysis is SPECIFIC (Claude returns concrete references to user's text), 9 problem ids present with new 5-part playbook keys (happening/why/control/action_today/longterm/reframe), AI memory returns patterns+monthly_narrative, home /snapshot returns encouragement/continue/week, tree timeline includes blossom + seedling milestone, weekly card has all 7 fields. No backend or frontend issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1255 lines — well past the 700-line threshold; strongly recommend modularising (auth/, mood/, solve/, memory/, tree/, home/) before next feature wave.
All AI endpoints (mood-dump, solve, memory, home encouragement, weekly headline) have safe JSON fallbacks on Claude failure — verified resilient.
Mood dump back-compat aliases (emotions/reflection/insight/suggestion) maintained alongside new themes/concerns/causes/perspective/action/validation — clean migration path.

Tree timeline correctly aggregates mood+journal+solve+mission+lifemap+focus blossom events and assigns stage milestones at thresholds 1/5/20/50/100 — verified seedling milestone fires on first blossom.
Home snapshot caches AI encouragement daily per user via encouragement_cache collection — good cost control.
MongoDB _id is excluded everywhere (verified via assertions on /mood-dump, /problem-solver/solve, /memory/insights, /home/snapshot, /tree/timeline, /retention/weekly-card).
All data-testid attributes from the spec are present and wired correctly in MoodDump.jsx, ProblemSolver.jsx, Home.jsx, Garden.jsx, Insights.jsx.
test_credentials: Per-run unique gmail teen (e.g. aiko<8hex>@gmail.com / lotus123). .test/.example/.invalid TLDs correctly rejected by Pydantic EmailStr.
seed_data_creation: Per-run unique teen + mood dump (2x) + solve (1x) creates blossom_count >= 3, sufficient for tree-timeline seedling milestone (threshold 1).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5.py -v for the iteration-5 contract (5-part mood, 9 problems with happening/why/control/action_today/longterm/reframe, memory_insights shape, home snapshot, tree timeline events with kind in mood/journal/solve/mission/lifemap/focus, weekly card with headline). UI testing: bypass the modal-only login by signing up via /api/auth/signup, calling /api/onboarding, then injecting token to localStorage key 'ikigai_token' before navigating to /home, /mood, /solve, /garden, /insights. Claude calls take 10-40s — use 70s timeouts on mood-fresh wait. Backend file is ~1255 lines and should be split.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found in iteration 5 polish.
